title: Training
enableDeveloperMode: Please enable Developer Mode in settings.
trainLocalOllama: Train local Ollama LLMs with your own data

uploadHelp.description: Upload emails or boarding passes to create training data.

annotation.title: Annotation:
annotation.description: After uploading, you must extract and correct the flight data

minimum.title: Minimum:
minimum.description: You need at least 5 annotated entries to start a training

stats.pendingHelp: Number of annotated entries that have not been trained yet.
stats.trainedHelp: Number of entries that have been successfully trained.

actions.startTrainingHelp: Start LoRA training with all pending entries. At least 5 entries are required.
actions.startTrainingHelpExpanded: Training uses LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) to fine-tune the base model. Depending on hardware (CPU/GPU), training may take several hours. Progress is displayed in real-time.

jobs.title: Training Jobs
jobs.titleHelp: Overview of all training jobs with status and progress.
jobs.titleHelpExpanded: Jobs can have different statuses: pending (waiting), running (in progress), completed (successful), failed. Click 'Details' to see logs and detailed progress.

progress.phaseHelp: Current phase of training. Progress is calculated based on logs.
progress.phaseHelpExpanded: Training phases: Initialization → Load Model → Prepare Dataset → Training (Epochs/Steps) → Save Model → Export to Ollama. Estimated remaining time is calculated based on current progress.

cancelTraining.title: Cancel Training?
cancelTraining.message:
Do you really want to cancel the training?

Current progress will be lost and cannot be recovered.

deleteTrainingData.title: Delete Training Data?
deleteTrainingData.message:
Do you really want to delete this entry?

This action cannot be undone.

bulkDelete.title: Delete multiple entries?
bulkDelete.message:
Do you really want to delete {{count}} entry?

This action cannot be undone.
bulkDelete.messagePlural:
Do you really want to delete {{count}} entries?

This action cannot be undone.

annotation.title: Email Annotation
annotation.description: First select a flight, then mark relevant text passages and assign labels to them
annotation.drawingInstructions: Draw a box. Press ESC or click "Cancel" to cancel.
annotation.boxSelected: Box {{index}} selected. Click on another box or change the label.
annotation.drawBoundingBoxes: Draw bounding boxes around relevant areas
